query: How do I connect to the VPN from my Windows work computer?
answer: Install the GlobalConnect client from the Software Center, then sign in with your work email and approve the push notification in the Authenticator app [vpn-01]. The VPN gateway is vpn.vasterby.example [vpn-01].

query: My VPN connection keeps cutting out during the working day
answer: Switch from Wi-Fi to a wired connection and disable power saving for the network adapter [vpn-02]. If the drops persist, report them with the client log file attached [vpn-02].

query: Hur får jag VPN att fungera på min Macbook?
answer: Installera GlobalConnect från Self Service på din Mac och ge appen behörighet under Systeminställningar > Integritet [vpn-03]. Starta sedan om datorn efter installationen [vpn-03].

query: I forgot my password, how can I change it myself?
answer: Reset your password at the self-service portal password.vasterby.example [pwd-01]. You need a registered mobile number to do this yourself [pwd-01].

query: Jag har glömt lösenordet och har inget mobilnummer registrerat
answer: Du måste besöka servicedesken med giltig legitimation [pwd-02]. Servicedesken i stadshuset är öppen vardagar 08–16 [pwd-02].

query: I typed the wrong password too many times and can't log in
answer: Your account locks after 10 failed sign-in attempts and unlocks automatically after 30 minutes [pwd-03]. Call the service desk if you need it unlocked sooner [pwd-03].

query: I got a new phone, how do I move my two-factor authentication?
answer: When you change phones, register the new device at mysignins before resetting the old one [mfa-01]. If the old phone is lost, the service desk can issue a temporary access pass valid for 8 hours [mfa-01].

query: How do I get access to our team's shared inbox?
answer: The mailbox owner requests access to a shared mailbox through the IT portal form 'Funktionsbrevlåda' [mail-01]. It then appears in Outlook within 2 hours after approval [mail-01].

query: My mailbox is out of space
answer: Your standard mailbox has a 50 GB quota, so empty Deleted Items and enable online archiving, which gives an additional 100 GB [mail-03].

query: I clicked a link in a suspicious email, what should I do?
answer: Change your password and call the service desk immediately [mail-04].

query: Hur skickar jag ett krypterat mejl till någon utanför kommunen?
answer: Skriv [SÄKER] i ämnesraden för att kryptera ett mejl till externa mottagare [mail-05]. Mottagaren får då en länk och en engångskod för att läsa meddelandet [mail-05].

query: How do I print in colour?
answer: Colour printing is disabled by default but managers can request colour rights for their unit through the IT portal [print-03]. Once enabled, print via the FollowMe queue and badge in at a printer to release the job [print-01]. The cost is charged to the unit at 1.20 SEK per page [print-03].

query: My laptop screen cracked when I dropped it
answer: Accidental damage is covered once per device lifetime [hw-02]. Report the damage in the IT portal and bring the laptop to the service desk, where a loaner can be provided while it is repaired [hw-02].

query: The screens connected through my desk dock show no picture
answer: Update the dock firmware from Software Center and reconnect the cable [hw-03]. If monitors connected to the standard USB-C dock stay black, this firmware update and reconnection is the recommended fix [hw-03].

query: Can I get admin rights on my computer?
answer: No, local administrator rights are not granted to regular users [sw-03]. Developers can apply for time-limited permissions via Privilege Management for a maximum of 4 hours [sw-03].

query: I need a program that is not in Software Center
answer: If the program is not in the Software Center, you need to submit a request with a business justification, and the security team will review it within 5 working days [sw-01].

query: I accidentally deleted a document from OneDrive last week
answer: You can restore the document yourself from the recycle bin, since deleted files in OneDrive can be recovered there for 93 days [files-02]. If it was deleted last week, it should still be available in the recycle bin [files-02].

query: How can I send a 300 GB file to a contractor?
answer: Use the Filöverföring service in the IT-portal, since it is intended for files larger than 250 GB [files-04]. The transfer link remains valid for 7 days [files-04].

query: I left my laptop on the train
answer: Report a lost laptop to the service desk immediately and file a police report [sec-01]. The device will be remotely wiped, and its disk is protected by BitLocker encryption [sec-01].

query: Vi har skickat personuppgifter till fel mottagare, vad gör vi?
answer: En personuppgiftsincident ska anmälas till dataskyddsombudet inom 24 timmar via formuläret i intranätet [sec-03]. Kommunen anmäler vidare till IMY inom 72 timmar vid behov [sec-03].

query: What happens to my account on my last day at work?
answer: Your account is disabled at 17:00 on your last employment day, which is the last day of your employment [acc-02]. Your mailbox is then kept for 90 days and can be forwarded to your manager on request [acc-02].

query: What wireless network should visitors use?
answer: Visitors should use the wireless network 'Vasterby-Gast' [wifi-01].

query: Can I work remotely from Thailand for a month?
answer: Working from outside the EU, including Thailand, requires approval from your manager and the security team, and you must apply at least two weeks before travel [remote-01].

query: When is the helpdesk open?
answer: The service desk is open weekdays 07:30–17:00 by phone on internal extension 4500 [ops-01]. Critical outages outside office hours go to the on-call technician via the same number [ops-01].

query: How do I get an older version of a SharePoint document back?
answer: Right-click the file and select Version history to restore an older version [files-05]. SharePoint stores up to 500 versions of a document [files-05].

query: Can I paste citizen data into an AI chatbot?
answer: No, you may not paste personal data into the AI assistant; generative AI tools may only be used with public information [sw-05]. If a personal data incident occurs, it must be reported to the data protection officer within 24 hours [sec-03].
